request.description: A wheat field shows orange-yellow pustules on upper leaf surfaces with chlorotic halos, affecting approximately 30-40% of the leaf area. The symptoms are consistent with brown rust. Current weather conditions are unknown and must be retrieved in real-time via a weather service before deciding whether fungicide application is warranted.

A tomato crop shows water-soaked lesions expanding rapidly on leaves, with suspected white sporulation on the underside and brown-black cankers on stems. Symptoms are consistent with late blight. Exact current temperature and leaf wetness hours are unavailable and must be retrieved from a real-time weather API to assess epidemic risk and urgency of fungicide application.

An olive grove inspection confirms oviposition stings on approximately 12% of sampled fruits and larval galleries visible upon cutting, consistent with Bactrocera oleae above the economic threshold. Current ambient temperature for spray efficacy assessment is unknown and must be verified via weather service before scheduling Deltamethrin application.

Wheat heads show bleached spikelets with pink-orange sporodochia at the spikelet base, consistent with Fusarium head blight. The field is currently at anthesis (GS 65). Weather conditions during the current anthesis window are unconfirmed and must be retrieved via API before assessing infection risk and deciding on emergency fungicide application.

A citrus grove shows asymmetric blotchy leaf mottling that does not follow vein patterns, lopsided small fruits with bitter taste, and twig dieback. A field diagnostic kit has returned positive for HLB. Current psyllid population density on new flush shoots is unknown and regional disease distribution data must be retrieved before determining the appropriate vector suppression protocol.
